title: Merge Sort
description:
Implement the merge sort algorithm. It should return a new sorted array without modifying the original.

Merge sort works by:
1. Splitting the array in half
2. Recursively sorting each half
3. Merging the two sorted halves

Example:
- Input: [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10] → Output: [3, 9, 10, 27, 38, 43, 82]
hints: Base case: arrays of length 0 or 1 are already sorted.
Split the array in half, recursively sort both halves, then merge them by comparing elements one at a time.
